description: A modern config library & High-performance visual toolkit for Fabric. Features NanoVG and Skia hardware acceleration, profile isolation, and dynamic HUD systems.

releases.notes:
## Changes
- Improved graphics resource cleanup when closing interfaces or recreating render targets.
- Improved handling of images released during interface rendering.
- Reduced font cache growth and improved fallback font handling in `MC-26.2` and `MC-26.3`.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed cosmetic preview resources remaining after switching screens.
- Fixed a mouse click bug in the ColorPicker on version `MC-26.3`.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where 3D rendering could lag or appear misaligned when the camera or player moved in Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3.

## New Features
- Added a shared tutorial system for 1.21.11, 26.2, and 26.3.
- Added automatic first-time onboarding, skip support, and saved completion status.
- Tutorials from multiple mods run sequentially to prevent overlap.

## Changes
- Improved processing efficiency when many scheduled tasks complete at once.
- Reduced unnecessary allocations during rendering.
- Reduced repeated text processing in selectors, text fields, and sliders.

## UI Changes
- Applied the current SILENCE UI/UX design guide to tutorial panels and controls.
- Added light and dark styling with hover, focus, and disabled states.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed crashes that could occur when handling certain emoji in selectors and text fields.
- Improved rendering resource cleanup.
- Fixed cosmetic images not being released when leaving the cosmetics screen.
- Fixed stale mouse button states after losing window focus or leaving a world.
- Fixed mouse button releases not being tracked outside a world.
- Fixed mouse keybinds remaining active after releasing the button.

## Changes
- Optimized sound logic
- Fixed an issue where SkijaRenderer was not properly cleaned up

## Changes
- Improved HUD caching and skipped unnecessary rendering when all HUDs are disabled.
- Added optional `getRenderCacheKey()` support for NanoVG HUDs.
- Reduced duplicate loading of shared cosmetic textures.
- Cached text wrapping results in the settings screen.
- Reduced repeated HUD configuration reads and file writes during slider adjustments.
- Prioritized core UI fonts and reduced retained font data.
- Added cleanup for unused rendering resources and consolidated Vulkan synchronization submissions.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed a crash that occurred when rendering rounded rectangles in `MC-26.3`.
